name: Daytrip
description: A spirited identity for local travel guides. A rolling compass, sunshine yellow, and friendly mid-century display type make nearby adventures feel like a special occasion.
heading: fraunces
rules: Compass points align vertically even when the surrounding badge rotates.
Use ticket-style borders with route information in a distinct lower strip.
Place sunshine behind short display headlines, not long itineraries.

system.concept: Mid-century map postcards, compass-cut sun shapes, warm destination tickets, and generously curved serif type. A familiar place becomes a fresh little journey.
headline: Go somewhere.
Make a day of it.
system.eyebrow: NEARBY ADVENTURES / A GOOD WAY TO GO
system.product: A ticket to a good day
system.productNote: A new view, not so far away.
features: Thoughtful guides to the places just beyond the usual route.
A more curious way to make a day feel different.
Useful details and small observations worth bringing along.
system.layoutNote: Sunlit centered hero with a postcard landscape and road-sign typography. Ticket-like borders, coral route chips, and plainly organized itinerary cards.
